content:
When we've announced our results at IMO-2025, several people asked if we're going to opensource our in-house Lean code. Over the past week-end, we've started the process by opening PRs adding more than 2K lines of code to Mathlib, see https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pulls?q=sort%3Aupdated-desc+is%3Apr+author%3Ayury-harmonic
The additions include missing API lemmas, missing @[simp]/@[norm_cast]/@[gcongr] attributes, Decidable instances, positivity and norm_num extensions, as well as a complete proof of Zsigmondy's theorem.
Over the next week or two, we plan to opensource even more Lean code.

P.S.: We're hiring, both Lean and AI experts, both for contractor and full time jobs. For details about available positions, please contact @Kirsten Henningsgard.
